scope: Actual React forms and Modal; deferred Auth/attendance services; no real network or database

results.name: attendance-pending
results.expectation: A hung save has a bounded recovery or explicit exit without losing the draft

results.name: password-reset-switch-pending
results.expectation: Switching from a stalled password request does not block recovery and the next login

results.name: attendance-partial-retry
results.expectation: Retry writes only the failed event; the earlier saved attendance is preserved

results.name: otp-pending-reopen
results.expectation: The email-code method can be retried after a stalled request; collapse/reopen must not keep it locked
